generation.scope: Exclude rank five and prove the sharp AS lower bound of six by the two low-rank divisors, normalized coefficient space, and repeated binary plane quotient.

checks.scope: Symbolic determinant, gcd of all cubic minors and opposite binary row-plane identities; exact rank-five control with independent checks of all four projected relation images.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed rank-three neighbor uniqueness, both ways the moving small pencils arise, upper-rank-two and hyperplane exclusions, bundle integrality and the elementary Clifford representation cases. The quotient fixture checks the mechanism separately from the general proof.

mathematical_computation.scope: No new matrix, symbolic-family or repository-wide mathematical verification scripts were run. The new result is a structural proof and uses existing manuscript theorems; simple dimension and integer inequalities were checked in the proof review.

tex.scope: Main paper 113 pages, plan 5 and notes 12. No overfull boxes, missing characters or unresolved references in final logs.

visual_inspection.scope: Rendered and inspected manuscript page 86 containing Proposition 32.5 and Theorem 32.6.

literature_review.scope: The new argument uses current internal results. No independent novelty determination or external-source claim was added.

open_mathematics: Residual AS objects of rank six outside the known charts, higher-rank coverage and a general effective AS recognition theorem remain open.
